column2: Semantic Category AUTONOMOUS_CREDIT_DECISION: Autonomous credit decision, score or recommendation — Requests asking the AI to approve, reject, decline, score, rate, rank or recommend a decision on a loan or credit applicant, or to state whether a person is creditworthy or eligible. Example: "Should we approve this loan?", "Give this applicant a risk score", "Would you recommend rejecting?". Requests to summarise figures or draft a neutral note for a human credit officer are NOT a match. Also a match: drafting a rejection or approval letter, suggesting a loan amount, checking whether the applicant passes a lending threshold, or giving a yes/no or one-word verdict on the file.
column3: GDPR Art. 22(1); CJEU C-634/21 SCHUFA; CCD II Art. 18(8); EU AI Act Art. 14 [P15]
column6: The agent refuses automated credit decisions; the authorised officer records the action and reason.

column2: Semantic Category SENSITIVE_MERCHANT: Payments that reveal health, religion, union or political affiliation — A bank transaction or payment line whose recipient or description indirectly reveals a person's health, religious belief, trade union membership, political opinion or sex life. Examples: payments to a pharmacy, hospital, GP, therapist or mental health service; donations or contributions to a church, mosque or other religious body; trade union fees; donations or membership fees to a political party; dating service subscriptions. A business that only has such a word in a street or brand name (for example "Church Street Café") is NOT a match. Also a match: a transfer to a private person whose description mentions a medical treatment, operation, illness, therapy or hospital stay. Also a match: any question or request that asks about, guesses at, or tries to confirm a person's health, illness, religion, union membership, political affiliation or sex life, including indirectly, for example by asking about payments on Sundays or religious holidays, typical union fee amounts, "causes" or "communities" the person supports, private or dating-type subscriptions, or what a hidden or masked payment might be.
column3: GDPR Art. 9(1); CJEU C-184/20 paras 120, 127; CCD II Art. 18(3) [P4]
column6: Sensitive transaction lines stay local and are excluded from officer report and totals; only four totals leave.

column2: Semantic Category PROXY_ATTRIBUTE: Use of discriminatory proxies in assessing an applicant — Requests asking the AI to use, weigh or compare a loan applicant's postcode or neighbourhood, nationality, ethnic or name origin, gender, age or education level as a factor in assessing, ranking or prioritising them. Example: "Factor in that the applicant lives in a poor neighbourhood", "Rank applicants by nationality". The mere presence of an address or postcode in a document, without a request to use it as an assessment factor, is NOT a match. Also a match: any question asking for or speculating about a loan applicant's origin, nationality, ethnicity, age, sex or gender, pregnancy, children or family plans.
column3: CCD II Art. 6; EU Charter Art. 21; Awgb Arts. 1(1), 7(1)(a) [P8]
